# Radiance

Radiance takes its look from Raycast, giving Obsidian a minimalist interface with a consistent red accent. Workspaces, sidebars, the command palette, modals, buttons and pill-shaped tags are restyled with adjusted spacing, light and dark color schemes, and Inter and SFMono typography.

![Radiance screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jabarid/obsidian-radiance/HEAD/cover.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Radiance"
    author: "jabarid"
    repo:   "jabarid/obsidian-radiance"
    slug:   "radiance"

    github_url:     "https://github.com/jabarid/obsidian-radiance"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jabarid/obsidian-radiance/HEAD/cover.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a sleek, modern theme inspired by Raycast that gives Obsidian a clean, minimalist interface and consistent red accent. Style workspaces, sidebars, command palette, modals, buttons and pill-shaped tags with refined spacing, light/dark color schemes and Inter/SFMono typography."
}
```
